surat.headline: Surat cluster sees input cost relief and diamond export surges amid retail textile inflation.
what_changed: Polyester FDY dropped 6.96 percent and staple fibre 4.33 percent due to crude and freight drops [b6b6f83da93a].
Lab-grown diamond exports surged 96 percent and natural diamonds grew 19 percent [ffee544acb58].
Surat diamond units shortened Diwali vacations from 25 days to 7 days on strong demand [20dc10f35062].
stress_signals: Rising inflation has curbed retail consumer buying, causing distress among local textile traders [0fed4a76da43].
improvement_signals: Crude oil dropped 17 percent over 10 days, easing Surat textile input costs [71350aa24679].
Gems and jewellery exports surged 34.01 percent ahead of Christmas driven by polished diamonds and studded gold [c3b68570a07d].
what_to_watch: Monitor inventory turnover and order book recovery in textile weaving and embroidery sub-segments.
Track working capital utilization and repayment timeliness for diamond units following shortened vacation breaks.
Assess consumer demand persistence in retail markets post-Christmas.
